failures: TestW05CP1SectionsOnly::test_select_only_produces_requested_missing — select_artifact_roles doesn't check ancestors of non-reusable requested roles
TestW05CN1DocumentHashChanged::test_hash_change_invalidates_old_artifacts — same root cause (sections not in valid_handles)
TestW05CN2FailureRetry::test_llm_fails_first_succeeds_second — ProduceForDemand doesn't retry; also MockProducer.produce called once

root_causes.description: select_artifact_roles only checks reusability of directly requested roles, not their ancestors. When a requested role (sections) is not in valid_handles, its valid ancestor (normalized) is never evaluated → not in reusable → sections fails DAG gate → empty artifact_read.

ProduceForDemand.produce calls each mock producer once. For retry testing, the orchestrator or producer needs retry logic. The mock's fail_count simulates the producer's internal retry, but the orchestrator doesn't trigger retries.
root_causes.fix_location: test mock design — make ProduceForDemand retry on failure
